basis: Owner final Phase 23 facts A-D supplied in this conversation.
student_charge: ILMERA charges the student a service charge between ₹3 lakh and ₹15 lakh, depending on destination and university. This is on top of the university's own fee.
university_payments: ILMERA also receives payments from some partner universities.
policy: ILMERA has a written service-fee and payment policy covering service inclusions and refund terms. The policy terms are not yet published on this site.
before_paying: Before paying, families should ask for the policy terms in writing and confirm in writing which amounts are university fees and which are ILMERA's service charge.
no_feedback: ILMERA is a new consultancy and has no student feedback yet. There are no published student reviews.
future_feedback: Future feedback will be published only with written permission and verified video.
